title: Timed insertion returns a permutation
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $x \in \alpha$, and let $xs$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$. Then the list obtained by timed ordered insertion of $x$ into $xs$ is a permutation of $x :: xs$, the list with $x$ prepended to $xs$.
replaced: The list returned by inserting $x$ into $\mathit{xs}$ is a permutation of $x :: \mathit{xs}$.
